annotations.title: Multi-Bond Portfolio Macro Shock, VaR/CVaR & Treasury Futures Immunization

description: Executes multi-position fixed-income portfolio stress testing across customizable macroeconomic rate shocks (parallel benchmark shifts in bps, rating-weighted credit spread widening in bps, yield curve twists: PARALLEL/STEEPENER/FLATTENER/INVERSION, and liquidity haircuts), computing aggregate portfolio DV01, 1-year 95%/99% parametric Value-at-Risk (VaR), 99% Expected Shortfall (CVaR), position-level P&L attribution, 10-Year Treasury Note futures (ZN) short hedge ratios, and portfolio-wide zero-cost European collar strikes. Use when: stress-testing a multi-bond portfolio under interest-rate or credit-spread shocks, calculating portfolio VaR/CVaR, or sizing 10Y Treasury futures duration hedges. Do not use when: pricing a single bond CUSIP without a macro shock scenario (use get_cusip_valuation instead) or checking single-CUSIP FINRA TRACE dealer prints (use get_debt_radar instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic portfolio simulation ($2.50 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; defaults to a 3-bond institutional benchmark portfolio if portfolio array is omitted; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

portfolio.description: Array of fixed-income bond positions to stress test (1 to 100 positions). If omitted or empty, defaults to a 3-position $10M institutional benchmark portfolio (UST 5Y, AAPL, GS).

coupon_rate_pct.description: Annual coupon rate as a percentage (e.g., 4.25).

credit_rating.description: Composite credit rating governing spread shock beta ("AAA", "AA", "A", "BBB", "BB", "B", "CCC", "NR").

face_value_usd.description: Par notional face value of the position in USD (e.g., 5000000).

issuer.description: Issuer legal or display name (e.g., "U.S. Treasury 5Y", "Apple Inc.").

market_price_pct.description: Current clean market price as a percentage of par (e.g., 98.50).

scenario.description: Macroeconomic stress scenario parameters applied across the portfolio. Defaults to a +100 bps parallel rate shock and +75 bps credit spread widening if omitted.

benchmark_rate_shock_bps.description: Parallel risk-free benchmark interest rate shift in basis points (e.g., 100 for +100 bps hike, -50 for -50 bps cut; default: 100).

credit_spread_widening_bps.description: Baseline BBB credit spread widening shock in basis points, scaled by rating beta (default: 75).

curve_twist.description: Yield curve shape regime applied across maturities ("PARALLEL", "STEEPENER", "FLATTENER", or "INVERSION"; default: "PARALLEL").

liquidity_haircut_pct.description: Bid-side market illiquidity haircut percentage deducted from post-shock value (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5%; default: 1.5).

name: run_portfolio_stress_test

immunization_and_hedging.description: Actionable 10Y Treasury Note futures (ZN) duration hedge and zero-cost option collar structure.

portfolio_summary.description: Pre-shock aggregate portfolio valuation and duration metrics.

portfolio_total_dv01_usd.description: Total portfolio dollar duration (DV01) in USD per 1bp shift.

total_market_value_usd.description: Aggregate pre-shock market value in USD.

position_level_breakdown.description: Per-CUSIP pre-shock and post-shock valuation and P&L attribution array.

receipt.description: Cryptographic payment or API key settlement receipt ID.

stress_test_results.description: Post-shock portfolio valuation, P&L loss, and resilience status.

portfolio_loss_pct.description: Percentage change in portfolio market value.

portfolio_pnl_usd.description: Net dollar profit/loss under the stress shock in USD.

post_shock_market_value_usd.description: Aggregate post-shock market value in USD.

value_at_risk.description: Parametric 1-year Value-at-Risk (95% and 99%) and Conditional VaR (99% Expected Shortfall) in USD.

title: Multi-Bond Portfolio Macro Shock, VaR/CVaR & Treasury Futures Immunization
